info.title: Attio Universal API

parentObject.description: The ID or slug of the parent object the note belongs to.

parentRecordId.description: The ID of the parent record the note belongs to.

title.description: The note title. The title is plaintext only and has no formatting.

format.description: Specify the format for the note content. Defaults to plaintext; choose markdown for rich formatting.

content.description: The main content of the note, formatted according to the format field.
content.example:
# Meeting Recap

- Reviewed Q3 metrics
- Agreed next steps

createdAt.description: Optional backdated created-at timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

meetingId.description: Optional meeting to associate with the note.

id.description: Note identifier payload containing workspace and note ids.
